Herbert Marcuse says something similar about "advanced industrial
society" in his book one dimensional man. In fact, if we compared tk's
manifesto to a more contemporary line of thought, It would have to be
that of the Frankfurt School, which included Marcuse,Theodor Adorno, and
Crane Brinton. Much of TK's philosophical outlook is directly related to 
their work. The catch however is that the aformentioned first worked for
the OSS{office of Strategic Services)  during world war two which may
have exonerated them from violent reprisal from those in power.
